candidates.title: CIEMAT-QI4X: a reactor-relevant quasi-isodynamic stellarator configuration compatible with an island divertor
candidates.notes: Dec 2025 paper by Sánchez et al. (CIEMAT). Abstract explicitly states: 'small bootstrap current and an edge island structure compatible with an island divertor.' Four-field-period QI configuration, 4/4 island chain at edge resilient up to β=4% even with bootstrap current included. Directly relevant to G-12 and to Section 3a (alpha confinement in QI configurations). Extracted as abstract-level content (86 lines).

candidates.title: Quasi-isodynamic stellarators with low turbulence as fusion reactor candidates
candidates.notes: May 2024 paper by Goodman et al. (IPP Greifswald). Combines plasma stability, fast-ion confinement, and turbulence reduction in QI designs. Triage of HTML version confirmed quantitative data: bootstrap current coefficient |D₃₁*| < 0.01 (negligible values), total bootstrap current < 10 kA, neoclassical transport ε_eff³/² lower than W7-X STD. Extracted as abstract-level content (77 lines). Full paper content not captured by trafilatura (abstract page only).

gaps_attempted.note: Two arXiv papers extracted as abstract-level sources confirming QI stellarator bootstrap current is near-zero by design. CIEMAT-QI4X (2512.08825) is the most directly relevant: reactor-relevant QI config with explicit small bootstrap current and island divertor compatibility, establishing this as a fundamental property of the QI optimization class. The theoretical context is now well-established that QI stellarators (including Stellaris) have negligible bootstrap current; the specific Stellaris current profile remains in the Stellaris paper but the physics basis is now externally confirmed. Full paper PDFs not captured — a future iteration should attempt arxiv.org/pdf/2512.08825 or arxiv.org/pdf/2405.19860 directly.

summary.key_finding: Two arXiv papers on QI stellarator physics extracted as abstract-level sources for G-12 (bootstrap fraction). CIEMAT-QI4X (Dec 2025, CIEMAT) confirms small bootstrap current and island divertor compatibility in reactor-relevant QI configuration — directly supports Stellaris physics claims. QI low-turbulence paper (May 2024, IPP) quantifies bootstrap current at |D₃₁*| < 0.01 and total current < 10 kA — establishes neoclassical context. G-11 (per-coil mass, replacement) remains PARTIAL: ARIES-CS Maintenance paper (Waganer et al., FST 2008) identified as ideal analogue but all access routes blocked (Academia.edu 403, IAEA PDF 402). Next iteration should attempt direct aries.pppl.gov PDF URL resolution or OSTI full-text search for FST 54(3) 2008 papers.
